related.title: 矽自旋交換閘：sqrt-SWAP 的面積帳本
related.titleEn: Silicon exchange gates: a sqrt-SWAP pulse-area ledger
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只在g模型與場方向已記錄時外插；若差頻也變動，不能僅修正共用時鐘。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Extrapolate only with documentedg and field direction; changing differences cannot be corrected by a common clock alone. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 從交換頻率求理想半交換時間，說明交換積分而非僅峰值決定旋轉。
related.differenceEn: Derive ideal half-swap duration and explain why integrated exchange, not only peak value, sets rotation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。均勻場B=0.5T，忽略超精細與磁場梯度，只做頻率帳本。 f=2×13.996×0.5。 代入 2*13.996*0.5，得到 13.996 GHz。電子自旋f=gμB B/h，採g=2與μB/h=13.996GHz/T；有效g可能依材料與方向改變。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。方形模型脈衝J/h=10MHz；無上升時間、洩漏與退相干。 t=1/(4×10MHz)，再換成ns。 代入 1/(4*10e6)*1e9，得到 25 ns。H=J S₁·S₂，以無因次自旋算符表示；sqrt-SWAP需Jt/ħ=π/2，因此t=1/(4J/h)。忽略場梯度。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Uniform B=0.5T, neglect hyperfine and gradients; this is a frequency ledger only. f=2×13.996×0.5. Substituting 2*13.996*0.5 gives 13.996 GHz. Electron-spin f=gμB B/h, usingg=2 andμB/h=13.996GHz/T; effectiveg can vary with material and direction. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Square model pulse J/h=10MHz with no rise time, leakage or dephasing. t=1/(4×10MHz), converted tons. Substituting 1/(4*10e6)*1e9 gives 25 ns. For H=J S1·S2 with dimensionless spins, sqrt-SWAP needsJt/ħ=π/2, so t=1/(4J/h), neglecting gradients. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
